annotation.speech2: Two curves above the x axis, with the points zero and one marked on the axis. The curve f 1 of x equals x cubed plus one, drawn in blue, rises from one to two across the interval from zero to one. The curve f 2 of x equals negative two x squared plus two x, drawn in vermillion, is an arch from zero up to one half and back to zero. Nothing between them is shaded: the region is left for the reader to draw.
The curve f 1 of x equals x cubed plus 1, drawn in blue.
The curve f 2 of x equals negative 2 x squared plus 2 x, drawn in vermillion.
